candidates.hook: Lady Harrington whispers, "Imagine Juliana seeing this."
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Harrington adds, "And everything that comes after it," leaving the audience wondering what fate awaits Juliana.
candidates.why: A chilling threat followed by an ominous promise creates instant tension and a question that forces viewers to watch the next episode.

candidates.hook: The massive cathedral doors swing open, flooding the nave with brilliant golden daylight.
candidates.cliffhanger: Rupert declares, "You look more queen than bride," and the clip cuts before the couple clasp hands, leaving the wedding’s outcome in suspense.
candidates.why: A dramatic visual hook and a romantic line set up a high‑stakes moment that stops scrolling and begs for resolution.

candidates.hook: Lord Harrington coldly says, "She won't be seeing anything for long."
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Harrington follows with, "And everything that comes after it," cutting before any action reveals the plan’s execution.
candidates.why: A direct threat to the heroine paired with a vague promise creates intrigue and a clear villain‑hero dynamic.

moments.desc: Lady Harrington whispers, "Imagine Juliana seeing this," a sharp threat to the condemned.
Elder Nobleman declares, "And its witch will be dead," a chilling promise of execution.
Elder Nobleman confirms, "All entrances are covered?" and guard replies, "Every one, my Lord," establishing the sealed trap.
Cathedral doors burst open, flooding light into the nave, pausing just before the bride appears.
